name: StarTropics
description: Nintendo's StarTropics (NES, 1990) as a native game, statically recompiled from your own cartridge dump.
author_notes: Bring your own StarTropics (USA) cartridge dump as a .nes file.
notes: Digests are of the No-Intro headered file, header included, because the launcher hashes NES files whole. The game itself checks the PRG+CHR data without the header (sha1 74c53fe9ac779f146c59ac01e701c9bf912b3c7b, crc32 889129cb), so dumps with other headers load in the game but will not match here.
